name: Resurrection Signet
description: Signet. Resurrects target party member ({{HealthPercentage}}% Health, {{EnergyPercentage}}% Energy). This signet only recharges when you gain a morale boost.

name: Signet of Capture
description: Signet. Choose one skill from a nearby dead Boss of your profession. Signet of Capture is permanently replaced by that skill. If that skill was elite, gain 250 XP for every level you have earned.

name: Lightbringer Signet
description: Signet. You gain {{AdrenalineGain}} strikes of adrenaline and {{EnergyGain}} Energy if you are within the area of a demonic servant of Abaddon.

name: Lightbringer's Gaze
description: Skill. Target demonic servant of Abaddon takes {{HolyDamage}} holy damage and is interrupted. Hits one additional foe in the area for each rank of Lightbringer you have attained. This skill is disabled ({{DisabledDuration}} seconds).

name: Sunspear Rebirth Signet
description: Signet. Resurrect target dead ally at your location (full Health and 10% Energy for each Sunspear Rank attained). This signet only recharges when you gain a morale boost.

name: Air of Superiority
description: Skill. ({{Duration}} seconds). Gain a random Asura benefit every time you earn experience from killing an enemy.

name: Asuran Scan
description: Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You cannot miss target foe. If you kill this foe, you lose 5% Death Penalty.

name: Mental Block
description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You have a 50% chance to block. Renewal: every time an enemy hits you.

name: Mindbender
description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You move {{SpeedBoostPercent}}% faster and cast Spells 20% faster.

name: Pain Inverter
description: Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Deals {{PercentOfDamage}}% of the damage (maximum 80) back to target foe every time it does damage.

name: Radiation Field
description: Ward Spell. (5 seconds.) Causes -{{HealthDegeneration}} Health degeneration to foes in the area. End effect: inflicts Disease condition ({{DiseaseDuration}} seconds) to foes in the area.

name: Smooth Criminal
description: Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Disables one Spell. This skill becomes that Spell. You gain {{EnergyGain}} Energy.

name: Summon Ice Imp
description: Spell. Summon a level {{IceImpLevel}} Ice Imp ({{Duration}} lifespan) that has Ice Spikes. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.

name: Summon Mursaat
description: Spell. Summon a level {{MursaatLevel}} Mursaat ({{Duration}} lifespan) that has Enervating Charge. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.

name: Summon Naga Shaman
description: Spell. Summon a level {{NagaShamanLevel}} Naga Shaman ({{Duration}} lifespan) that has Stoning. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.

name: Summon Ruby Djinn
description: Spell. Summon a level {{RubyDjinnLevel}} Ruby Djinn ({{Duration}} lifespan) that has Immolate. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.

name: Technobabble
description: Spell. Deals {{Damage}} damage to target and adjacent foes. Inflicts Dazed condition ({{DazedDuration}} seconds) on these foes if target was not a boss.

name: "By Ural's Hammer!"
description: Shout. (30 seconds.) Resurrect all dead party members in earshot with full Health and Energy. Affected party members deal {{IncreasedDamagePercent}}% more damage. Affected party members die when it ends, but do not receive a death penalty.

name: "Don't Trip!"
description: Shout. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Prevents knock-down; affects party members within earshot.

name: Alkar's Alchemical Acid
description: Spell. Projectile: deals {{Damage}} damage to target and adjacent foes. Deals {{AdditionalDamage}} more damage and inflicts Cracked Armor condition ({{CrackedArmorDuration}} seconds) to Destroyers.

name: Black Powder Mine
description: Trap. (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Deals {{FireDamage}} damage. Inflicts Blindness and Bleeding conditions ({{BlindAndBleedingDuration}} seconds). Easily interrupted.

name: Brawling Headbutt
description: Touch Skill. Deals {{Damage}} damage; causes knock-down.

name: Breath of the Great Dwarf
description: Spell. Removes burning and heals for {{Healing}} Health. Affects party members.

name: Drunken Master
description: Stance. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You move and attack {{SpeedIncreasePercentIfSober}}% faster if you are not drunk. You move and attack {{SpeedIncreasePercentIfDrunk}}% faster if you are drunk.

name: Dwarven Stability
description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Your stances last {{StanceDurationIncreasePercent}}% longer. You cannot be knocked-down if you activated this skill while drunk.

name: Ear Bite
description: Touch Skill. Deals {{PiercingDamage}} piercing damage and inflicts Bleeding condition ({{BleedingDuration}} seconds).

name: Great Dwarf Armor
description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) +24 armor and +60 maximum Health. Additional +24 armor against Destroyers.

name: Great Dwarf Weapon
description: Weapon Spell. (20 seconds.) +{{Damage}} weapon damage and {{KnockDownChancePercent}}% chance to cause knock-down with attacks. Cannot self-target.

name: Light of Deldrimor
description: Spell. Deals {{HolyDamage}} holy damage to foes in the area. Pings hidden objects within the area on the compass.

name: Low Blow
description: Touch Skill. Deals {{Damage}} damage. Inflicts {{ConditionalDamage}} damage and Cracked Armor ({{CrackedArmorDuration}} seconds) if target foe is knocked down.

name: Snow Storm
description: Spell. Deals {{ColdDamage}} cold damage each second (5 seconds). Hits foes adjacent to target foe's initial location.

name: Deft Strike
description: Ranged Attack. Deals {{ArmorignoringDamage}} damage. Inflicts Bleeding condition ({{BleedingDuration}} seconds) if target foe has Cracked Armor.

name: Ebon Battle Standard of Courage
description: Ward Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Allies in this ward have +24 armor and +24 more armor against Charr. Spirits are unaffected.

name: Ebon Battle Standard of Honor
description: Ward Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Allies in this ward deal +{{Damage}} damage and +{{DamageVsCharr}} more damage against Charr. Spirits are unaffected.

name: Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom
description: Ward Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Spells that allies in this ward cast have a {{HsrChancePercent}}% chance to recharge 50% faster. Spirits are unaffected.

name: Ebon Escape
description: Spell. Heals you and target ally for {{Healing}}. Initial effect: Shadow Step to this ally. Cannot self-target.

name: Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support
description: Spell. Summon a level {{AssassinLevel}} assassin that has Iron Palm, Fox Fangs, and Nine Tail Strike; it Shadow Steps to this foe. If this foe is a Charr, the assassin lives for {{DurationVsCharr}} seconds. If target foe is not a Charr, the Assassin lives for {{DurationVsOtherFoes}} seconds.

name: Ebon Vanguard Sniper Support
description: Spell. Deals {{PiercingDamage}} piercing damage and inflicts Bleeding condition ({{BleedingDuration}} seconds). 10% chance of +{{AdditionalPiercingDamage}} piercing damage. 25% chance of +{{AdditionalPiercingDamage}} piercing damage if target foe is a Charr.

name: Signet of Infection
description: Signet. Inflicts Diseased condition {{DiseaseDuration}} seconds if target foe is Bleeding.

name: Sneak Attack
description: Melee Attack. Inflicts Blindness ({{BlindDuration}} seconds). Counts as a lead attack.

name: Tryptophan Signet
description: Signet. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Target and adjacent foes move and attack {{SpeedReductionPercent}}% slower.

name: Weakness Trap
description: Trap. (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Deals {{LightningDamage}} lightning damage. Inflicts Weakness condition ({{WeaknessDuration}} seconds). Knocks-down Charr. Easily interrupted.

name: Winds
description: Ebon Vanguard Ritual. Creates a level {{Level}} spirit ({{Duration}} second lifespan.) Affects foes within range. 15% chance to miss with ranged attacks.

name: "Dodge This!"
description: Shout. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Your next attack is unblockable and deals +{{Damage}} damage.

name: "Finish Him!"
description: Shout. Deals {{Damage}} damage and inflicts Cracked Armor and Deep Wound conditions ({{CrackedArmorAndDeepWoundDuration}} seconds). No effect unless target foe has less than 50% Health.

name: "I Am Unstoppable!"
description: Shout. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You have +24 armor and cannot be knocked-down or Crippled.

name: "I Am the Strongest!"
description: Shout. Your next {{OfAttacks}} attacks deal +{{AdditionalDamage}} damage.

name: "You Are All Weaklings!"
description: Shout. Inflicts Weakness condition ({{WeaknessDuration}} seconds). Also affects adjacent foes.

name: "You Move Like a Dwarf!"
description: Shout. Deals {{Damage}} damage, causes knock-down, and inflicts Crippled condition ({{CrippledDuration}} seconds).

name: A Touch of Guile
description: Touch Hex Spell. Deals {{ArmorignoringDamage}} damage. Target foe cannot attack ({{Duration}} seconds) if it was knocked-down.

name: Club of a Thousand Bears
description: Melee Attack. Deals +{{DamagePerFoe}} damage for each adjacent foe (maximum 60 damage). Causes knock-down if target foe is non-human.

name: Feel No Pain
description: Skill. (30 seconds.) You have +{{HealthRegeneration}} Health regeneration. You have +{{ConditionalMaximumHealth}} maximum Health if you are drunk when activating this skill.

name: Raven Blessing
description: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the Raven (60 seconds). All your attributes are set to 0 and raven attacks replace your skills, and you have 80 armor, {{MaximumHealth}} Health, and a {{BlockChancePercent}}% block chance.

name: Ursan Blessing
description: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the bear (60 seconds). All your attributes are set to 0 and bear attacks replace your skills, and you have 100 armor and {{MaximumHealth}} Health.

name: Volfen Blessing
description: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the wolf (60 seconds). All your attributes are set to 0 and wolf attacks replace your skills, and you have 80 armor, {{MaximumHealth}} Health and {{HealthRegeneration}} Health regeneration.
